event.description: Constrain the shared feed-forward input map to be symmetric
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 41 prior macro-attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0095/micro-0001 at 1,672 parameters/99.01%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0104, whose same-orientation whole-map FF reuse scored 0.00% at 1,465 parameters. Hypothesis: the input transform needs an independent output transform but not directed feature-to-feature coefficients. Constrain only the 16x16 shared FF input map to a learned symmetric matrix, initialized by averaging transpose pairs; retain all 16 GELU units and the independent retained output map, yielding 1,572 parameters. This is more informative than symmetric output first because feature construction precedes the nonlinearity and symmetry preserves reciprocal interactions without tying analysis to synthesis, directly separating matrix geometry from the failed whole-map reuse.
